cli.help:
Usage: resonance-cli <command> [arguments]

  status                       Battery, mode, codec, now playing
  json                         Full state as JSON

  nc                           Noise cancelling
  ambient [1-20]               Ambient sound (optional level)
  off                          Neither noise cancelling nor ambient sound
  voice on|off                 Focus on voice (ambient sound)
  auto on|off                  Auto ambient sound
  toggle                       Next mode (NC -> ambient -> off)

  eq                           List presets and show the current setting
  eq <preset>                  e.g. eq heavy, eq off, eq custom
  eq bands <10 values>         Gains from -6 to +6, 31 Hz to 16 kHz

  dsee on|off                  DSEE Extreme
  bgm on|off [office|living|cafe]   Background music
  stc on|off                   Speak-to-chat

  volume [0-30]                Read or set the volume
  play | pause | next | prev

  devices                      Devices remembered by the headphones
  connect <name|address>       Connect a remembered device
  disconnect <name|address>    Disconnect a device
  poweroff --yes               Turn the headphones off

When the Resonance app is open, commands go through it (instant).
Advanced tools: list, scan, deepscan, send, listen, test, device
